title: TEE Attack Record
description: Schema for a single TEE attack curated in data/attacks/<name>.json.

name.description: Attack name. Must match the filename (without .json).

year.description: Year the attack was published or disclosed.

affected_platforms.description: List of platform identifiers affected by this attack.

category.description: Attack category from the TEEAttack taxonomy.

cost_to_attack.description: Estimated cost or difficulty to mount the attack (e.g., '~$10', 'Unknown').

mitigation_type.description: Mitigation class: patch (firmware/microcode/software fix), deployment-control (hardware exploit mitigated by deployment controls, not a patch), accept (no mitigation available).

mitigation_verification.description: How the mitigation is verified: tcb-svn (quote TCB vs curated threshold), tcb-svn-pending (fix exists, SVN mapping unconfirmed), guest-evidence (kernel/guest-side fix, needs the M1 anchoring layer), deployment-control (deployment choice, not patchable), none (no fix shipped). Unverified = unmitigated.

adversary_position.description: Where the attacker must stand to mount the attack. An attack counts under a threat model only when every position it requires is granted by that model (docs/THREAT-MODELS.md).

mitigation_coverage.description: Fraction of the attack's vectors still applicable given mitigations the engine can verify. 1.0 = fully applicable (the default: unverified mitigation counts whole), 0.5 = half mitigated, 0.0 = fully mitigated. Scales the threat penalty (docs/GRADING.md).

cve_ids.description: Public CVE identifiers associated with this attack.

paper_url.description: URL to the research paper, advisory, or canonical reference.

boundary_statement.description: Honest statement of what the engine can or cannot claim about this attack.

mapping_sources.description: Per-platform primary-source evidence backing the affected_platforms tags. Empty object means the attack has no affected_platforms (no matching taxonomy platform).

evidence.description: Quoted passage or precise finding from the source that establishes this platform mapping.

patched.description: Whether the attack is considered fully patched in current TCB versions.

min_svn.description: Per-platform minimum TCB version that fixes this attack.

compliance_controls.description: Framework control IDs this attack implicates.
